# lz4-sys, vendored and patched for ggcat

Upstream: crates.io `lz4-sys` 1.11.1+lz4-1.10.0 (MIT; liblz4 BSD-2-Clause).
Crate file sha256: `6bd8c0d6c6ed0cd30b3652886bb8711dc4bb01d637a68105a3d5158039b418e6`.

## Why

`lz-copyback` needs every LZ match liblz4's frame decoder decodes, with its absolute offset
in the output. liblz4 has no such hook, so the block decoder and the frame decoder are
patched. With no hook published, the block decoder gains one thread-local load per block
and one predictable NULL check per match.

## Pruning

Kept: `build.rs`, `Cargo.toml`, `LICENSE`, `src/lib.rs`, and from `liblz4/` the licences,
the README and the sources `build.rs` compiles (`lib/lz4.{c,h}`, `lib/lz4frame.{c,h}`,
`lib/lz4frame_static.h`, `lib/lz4hc.{c,h}`, `lib/xxhash.{c,h}`). Dropped: the rest of
`liblz4/` (programs, tests, examples, contrib, docs, build scripts, `lz4file.*`), and the
wasm shim: its `#[no_mangle]` allocator functions would collide with the genuine
`lz4-sys`'s in the same binary, so this fork does not build for `wasm32-unknown-unknown`.

## Patch (`ggcat-lz-hook.patch`)

* `liblz4/lib/lz4.h`: in the static-linking section, the `LZ4_lzMatchHook` and
  `LZ4_lzHookState` (hook, ctx, base, minimum length) types and `LZ4_setLzHookState()`.
* `liblz4/lib/lz4.c`: the thread-local `LZ4_lzHookState` pointer and its setter, defined past
  `LZ4_COMMONDEFS_ONLY` so that `lz4hc.c` (which includes `lz4.c`) does not get a copy.
  `LZ4_decompress_generic()` loads it once per call, with the minimum length into a local
  (`SIZE_MAX` without a hook, so a match costs one comparison and the short ones never leave
  C), and reports every long enough match once, with its full length, before copying it, at
  the four places a match is complete: the fast loop's
  shortcut, the fast loop's general path (after the offset check), the safe loop's
  shortcut (whose `length` does not include `MINMATCH` yet), and the safe loop's general
  path at `safe_match_copy` (after the offset check), which also takes the matches the fast
  loop sends there. A block is decoded whole, so a match is never split.
* `liblz4/lib/lz4frame.{c,h}`: `lzTotalOut`, `lzHook`, `lzHookCtx`, `lzHookMinLength`,
  `lzHookLastEnd` and `lzHookLastOffset` in `LZ4F_dctx` (zeroed by the context's allocation,
  never reset, so the offsets run on across frames);
  `LZ4F_setLzMatchHook(dctx, hook, ctx, minLength, lastEnd, lastOffset)`;
  `LZ4F_decompressBlock()`, which publishes
  `{hook, ctx, base = lzTotalOut, minLength, lastEnd, lastOffset}` around both block decodes,
  takes the last match's end and offset back after them, and counts their output. A match
  shorter than `minLength` is reported when it continues the last one reported, from
  `lastEnd` at the same offset, so the tail of a repeat cut into matches is kept however
  short;
  uncompressed blocks are counted in `dstage_copyDirect`. When the caller's buffer is
  smaller than a block, the block is decoded into `tmpOut` and flushed over later calls, so
  its matches are reported up to one block before their bytes reach the caller. Linked-block
  history management only copies bytes, so no match is reported twice.
* `src/lib.rs`: `#[link_name = "lzcb_..."]` on every function (`tools/add-link-names.py`),
  the declaration of `LZ4F_setLzMatchHook`, and the wasm-only branches removed.
* `build.rs`: the forced `lzcb_prefix.h` include, re-runs when the patched files change,
  the wasm shim removed.
* `Cargo.toml`: renamed to `lzcb-lz4-sys` (lib `lzcb_lz4_sys`), `links = "lzcb_lz4"`.

The Rust side (`../../src/lz4.rs`) installs the hook around every `LZ4F_decompress` call and
clears it afterwards.

## Packaging for crates.io (lzcb fork)

As for the other C forks: `links = "lzcb_lz4"` instead of `"lz4"`, every exported C symbol
renamed into the `lzcb_` namespace by the force-included `lzcb_prefix.h` (139 symbols,
`XXH*` included), and `#[link_name]`s keeping the Rust-visible names. `lzcb_prefix.h` is
generated by `tools/gen-symbol-prefix.sh lz4-sys liblzcb_lz4.a`; `tests/symbols.rs` fails if any
global definition of the built archive lost its prefix. The archive is `liblzcb_lz4.a`, not `liblz4.a`: its directory goes
on the search path of the final link, where a `liblz4.a` would be taken for the `-llz4` of a
crate linking the system library.

## Upgrading

1. Copy the new upstream crate, prune as above.
2. `git apply -p1 ggcat-lz-hook.patch` from the crate directory and resolve conflicts; check
   that every match site of `LZ4_decompress_generic()` still reports exactly once.
3. `tools/gen-symbol-prefix.sh lz4-sys liblzcb_lz4.a`.
4. `cargo test --workspace` at the lz-copyback root: the symbol audit, and
   `tests/lz4_frames.rs`, which checks the reported matches against the ones read straight
   from the frames.
5. `tools/gen-patch.sh lz4-sys <upstream-dir>` to refresh this patch.
